# Components

## Application Security Management (WAF)

* :bug: Bumps io.sqreen:libsqreen from 17.6.0 to 17.7.0, which moves the bundled libddwaf from 2.0.1 to 2.2.1. The gradle.lockfile updates are in the stacked https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-java/pull/13370 (one line per file).
   * Handles a libddwaf 2.2.0 behaviour change in AppSecConfigServiceImpl. A rejected config update now unregisters its path (https://github.com/DataDog/libddwaf/pull/523), so:
remove() no longer fails when WafBuilder.removeConfig throws for that path, and always runs its cleanup;
a rejected ASM_DD update forgets its key, so the default rules come back when no other ASM_DD config is left.
  * Raises the agent jar size budget from 34.5 to 35 MiB: libsqreen 17.7.0 adds about 150 KiB of native code, which put the jar 125 KiB over the budget.
  * Adds regression tests for the SSRF fix: a unit test against the bundled rules (rasp-934-100) and a new row in the rasp blocks on SSRF smoke test.
* :bug: Add AppSec request blocking to the Jetty 12 instrumentation (#13317 - @jandro996)
* :sparkles: Resolve client IPs for Java Lambda AppSec events (#13219 - @claponcet)
* :bug: Fix AppSec initialization when libc detection is denied (#13162 - @claponcet)
* :bug: Fixes a SIGSEGV in libsqreen_jni.so JNI_OnLoad during AppSec initialization. (#13135)
* :bug: reject new WAF contexts once handle closure begins. (#13135)
* :bug: Fix flaky WAFModuleHandleReloadRaceTest wait assertion (#13133 - @cgcote)
* :sparkles: Update default AppSec ruleset to release 1.19.0 (#13121 - @jandro996)

## Profiling

* :bug: Bump java-profiler (ddprof) to 1.52.1 (#13044 - @kaahos)
  * Measure native allocator overhead instead of assuming a fixed factor.
  * Improve stack frame attribution and AArch64 runtime stub unwinding.
  * Record the remote symbolication mode in JFR.
  * Add upstream reference-chain tracking and leak-signal detection, with liveness and recycled-tag identity fixes
  * Fix dictionary and call-trace table reclamation after drain timeouts, preserve string IDs across dictionary rotation, and correct live-trace preservation.
  * Fix duplicate and biased thread selection in wall-clock sampling, native socket hook timestamps, and continuation metadata lookup and frame alignment.
  * Add the upstream fjmethodid=lazy option for profiling HotSpot without jmethodIDs.
